title: Clipp Urban Mobility Platform
tagline: Multi-modal urban transportation app connecting commuters with on-demand transit, routing, and digital payments.
description: Engineered real-time routing, geolocation tracking, and payment processing for high-volume urban commuters.
architecture: Event-driven mobile architecture with WebSocket streaming for live vehicle telemetry, background location services, and payment gateway integrations.
highlights: Maintained sub-second map rendering and real-time vehicle dispatch updates
Engineered fault-tolerant offline ticketing and digital wallet checkout flows
Reduced cold start latency and improved battery consumption during active routes
